notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Game settings have been separated from the save file into a local file that isn’t stored in steam cloud
[*]Pressing ‘backspace’ in the main menu, options menu or keybindings menu resets bindings back to default
[*]The chest platform in underground bonus areas is now higher up, preventing the player from accessing it by unintended means, also made adjustments to the crumbling platform generation in said areas
[*]Fixed a case where the game could crash if the player dies right as a journey is completed
[*]Fixed a collision bug that allowed the player to get stuck inside the side of an island while the boat is moving
[*]Fixed problems with diagonal collision
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
A tiny patch just to fix something I couldn't get done in time for the previous one.
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the game could consistently freeze after defeating certain bosses.
[/list]
That should do it for all the bugs and crashes that have been reported to me so far. Hope everyone is enjoying the game! :lunar2019piginablanket:

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
A quick patch to address some crashes and other issues.
[list]
[*]Certain companion choices no longer crash the game or cause other strange behaviour in the moonlit gate sequence
[*]The player no longer falls through the boat when holding down as the combat tutorial starts
[*]Chasers no longer crash the game in certain, very specific situations
[*]The electric walls created by the larger medusa enemies now properly damage the player
[*]Made the final boss easier in various ways
[*]Added water particles to the rear of the boat
[/list]
[strike][b]Note: If the game gets stuck or crashes for you specifically on one of the bosses, please get in touch with me. I'm unable to replicate these issues for myself and I really need to get my hands on a save file where they are present.[/b][/strike]
